children: ICICI Securities research report on Bajaj Finance

Bajaj Finance (BFL) stands out in the NBFC space for its effective capital utilisation and strong cross-cycle returns – it has delivered 34%/46% AUM/PAT CAGRs with an average 18% RoE over FY08–26. BFL recently raised INR 175bn through a QIP and promoter warrants, which is projected to drive an 8–10% accretion in FY27–28E BVPS. Unlike past capital raises, executed at over 5x leverage, the current round occurs at under 5x leverage while sustaining an RoE of ~20%, thus signalling structurally improved profitability. BFL aims for retail credit market share expansion to 3.5–4% by FY30, from 2.8% currently, implying 23–25% AUM/PAT CAGRs each and RoE of 19–21%.
Maintain BUY with a revised TP to INR 1,350 (earlier INR 1,250), valuing BFL at 4.5x on consolidated Sep’27E BVPS.
